tagline.zh: 今天长一点点，也算好好向前。
tagline.en: A little growth today is still a step forward.

description.zh: 暂时看不见变化，也可以继续相信自己的积累。
description.en: Small changes can be growing before you notice them.

editorial.promiseZh: 今天长一点点，也算好好向前。
editorial.promiseEn: A little growth today is still a step forward.
editorial.storyZh: 芽团每天都会抬头看看自己的两片叶子。它曾经盼着一觉醒来就能长成遮住整张桌子的大树，结果等了许久，变化小得几乎看不见。线眠陪它在纸边留下一道小小的记号，过几天再回来看看。原来叶尖已经悄悄越过那里。芽团高兴得晃了好一会儿，从此不再盯着遥远的树冠，而是认真迎接今天能吸收的一点阳光。它也会把这份耐心借给桌边的朋友：慢慢做，正在长大的事情不会因为暂时看不见，就停止生长。
editorial.storyEn: Spriggle used to hope its two leaves would become a great tree overnight. For days the change seemed too small to see. Spoolie helped it mark a tiny line beside the desk. When they returned, the leaf tips had quietly grown past it. Spriggle swayed with delight. Now it welcomes whatever sunshine today offers, rather than watching a distant treetop. It shares that patience with its neighbors: something can be growing even before the change becomes easy to see.
editorial.comfortZh: 暂时看不见变化，也可以继续相信自己的积累。
editorial.comfortEn: Small changes can be growing before you notice them.

moments.bodyZh: 把今天做过的一件小事记下来。
moments.bodyEn: Keep a note of one small thing you did today.

moments.bodyZh: 只和昨天的自己比一比，给成长一点时间。
moments.bodyEn: Look back at yesterday and give growth a little time.

moments.bodyZh: 给它留一个固定的小位置，明天再来照顾。
moments.bodyEn: Give it a small place in your day and return tomorrow.

editorial.matchZh: 适合慢慢学习、养成习惯，或需要看见小进步的你。
editorial.matchEn: For steady learning, little habits, and noticing small steps forward.
